title: imrestore: Adaptive and Quasi-Newton First-Order Methods for Image Restoration
description: A Python package of adaptive and quasi-Newton first-order methods for image restoration: adaptive gradient descent (Malitsky & Mishchenko, 2020), inertial quasi-Newton forward-backward splitting (Wang, Fadili & Ochs, 2022), and the primal-dual algorithm with linesearch with its variable-metric extension (Malitsky & Pock, 2018; Wang, Fadili & Ochs, 2024), with Gaussian blur and total-variation operators, proximal maps, and PSNR/SSIM metrics. All methods are independent reimplementations from the papers.
